title: Bifarious
summary: BIFA'RIOUS, adjective [Latin bifarius; bis and fero, or Teutonic, faran, to go.] Two-fold. In botany, pointing two ways, as leaves that grow only on opposite sides of a branch.

inlines.v: BIFA'RIOUS, adjective [Latin bifarius; bis and fero, or Teutonic, faran, to go.] Two-fold. In botany, pointing two ways, as leaves that grow only on opposite sides of a branch.
